1540.d: Getting there • Use the Manor farm Teleport spell and walk east. • Use the Ardougne Lodestone and walk northeast to the excavation entrance. • Use the Seers' Village Lodestone and walk southeast to the excavation entrance. • Use the "Guthix's Shrine" teleport on the Sixth-Age circuit to teleport directly to the monument, run west to the tunnel entrance, then choose "Go to the central chamber." This requires first claiming it from the Guthixian High Druid after completing all of the quests that are optionally prerequisite to The World Wakes. • Use the Mask of the Automatons/Helm of the Automatons to teleport directly to the cave. • Use the Fairy ring code BLR, which lands you outside of the Legends' Guild, and walk northwest to the excavation entrance.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use the Manor farm Teleport spell and walk east.
• Use the Ardougne Lodestone and walk northeast to the excavation entrance.
• Use the Seers' Village Lodestone and walk southeast to the excavation entrance.
• Use the "Guthix's Shrine" teleport on the Sixth-Age circuit to teleport directly to the monument, run west to the tunnel entrance, then choose "Go to the central chamber." This requires first claiming it from the Guthixian High Druid after completing all of the quests that are optionally prerequisite to The World Wakes.
• Use the Mask of the Automatons/Helm of the Automatons to teleport directly to the cave.
• Use the Fairy ring code BLR, which lands you outside of the Legends' Guild, and walk northwest to the excavation entrance.

Requirements
• * 67 Slayer

Large Chamber

Upon asking the Guthixian High Druid for a teleport (or right-clicking him), you will end up in the large chamber of the room. The Automatons are not aggressive despite their combat level, although they do possess a mechanic that causes a soft typeless AoE attack within 2 squares of the automaton.

There are seven Automaton Guardians in the middle, along with eight Automaton Tracers and Automaton Generators on both sides. Down the large chamber leads to a small hallway and elevator (used to enter the chamber during the quest) that contains two of each automaton; the Guardians in the hallway, and the Tracers and Generators on the elevator. The chamber is not teleport restricted and can be left by either entering the large hole to Guthix's Shrine or using the elevator to arrive at the surface. Note that the elevator cannot be activated while in combat.

1638.d: Azzanadra's Quest is a quest which is the early part of the The Elder God Wars quest series and features Azzanadra and Trindine.

1639.d: Overview Quest details page | Azzanadra's Quest

gt.heading: Travel through Freneskae
gt.text:
• Travel to the World Gate and talk to Azzanadra. Teleporting, logging out or going to lobby will require starting this part over from this step.
• Use the Sixth-Age circuit to teleport, or run south from the Eagles' Peak lodestone, or teleport to the Outpost with a traveller's necklace and run west.
• Equip a face mask or masked earmuffs to protect against volcanic ash. Having a slayer helmet on the slayer helmet stand counts for this.
• Enter the World Gate, travelling to the 'Approach' destination (first option). Make sure to finish the dialogue with Azzanadra upon entry.
• Head east over the ledges, then up the cliffside.
• Continue east, climbing down the drop, then talk to Azzanadra to the south-east. [Chat: 4 Let's just keep going]
• Continue north, crossing the stepping stones and up the cliffside.
• Continue north, wall run the overhang and talk to Azzanadra again. [Chat: 4 Let's just keep going]
• Climb the cliffside, continue west and slide down the slope and head west.
• You can heal up by standing under the archway with the glowing crystals.
• Continue south, wrapping around east and north, then climb the nearby cliffside which is south of the archway.
• Walk across the rock formation and talk to Azzanadra again. [Chat: 4 Let's just keep going]
• Continue east and climb down the drop, then traverse the rock bridge to the east.
• Talk to Azzanadra again.
• Enter the opening.
